reviews.text: Blake did an incredible job on our fence! He's extremely knowledgeable when it comes to your fencing needs. Fancy Fence provided quality work, at a competitive price. We will definitely be using him again in the future!
reviews.author: Kristi

reviews.text: Blake did an amazing job on our fence!  He listened to everything I wanted and explained my options and cost and when he was done, it was exactly how I saw it! Thank you so much for all your hard work! I would recommend Fancy fence to everyone, you cant go wrong with them!
reviews.author: Rolanda Michaud

reviews.text: We needed our wood fence replaced. I called Blake and a few days later he was here to give us an estimate. The fence he put in is great. His workers did not mind working in 100+ degree days. The fence looked so good my neighbor wanted their fence replaced.  Mike built a huge fence in the front and I can get almost anything through it. Thanks Blake for my new fence.
reviews.author: Lydia Olinger

reviews.text: Great company to work with! The team was professional, quick, and did an excellent job on my fence. Highly recommend them if you want quality work done right.
reviews.author: Matheus Soares

reviews.text: Blake gave the best estimate for replacing ten wooden 4x4 posts for an 8-foot wooden fence, so I contracted with him. He was on the job site both days for the repair. His crew was professional and courteous. They removed the panels and used a farmjack to pull the rotting 4x4 wooden posts out of the ground. They installed heavy gauge galvanized fence posts and replaced the existing fence panels. They performed a few extra things to get the best results - minor tree trimming, sprinkler shrubbery riser removal/reinstall, and minor landscaping. No damage to nearby sprinkler lines and landscaping. I was very pleased with the results.
reviews.author: Glenn Rosenberger

reviews.text: Great job, The team worked fast and made sure everything was solid and straight. They were polite and easy to talk to. Now my yard feels safe and private.
reviews.author: Sonyx solutions

reviews.text: Blake was great, listened and determined what I wanted and what needed to be done.  He make quick work out of the project and ensured it was what I wanted.  I would use him again for fence repair.  Thanks Blake!
reviews.author: Marlena Mossbarger

reviews.text: I have been using Blake for years.  Most recently he completed a total fence replacement on our home in Frisco.  No need to spend a bunch of time searching for the perfect price/quality combo because Blake is your guy.  Honest, A+ integrity, and genuinely interested in making his customers happy.  His work is phenominal as well!!!
reviews.author: Michael Baier
